d: The central government has convened a one-day session for each of the two houses of Parliament. The Lok Sabha will meet on November 30, and the Rajya Sabha will meet on December 2, 2026. The proceedings of both houses are expected to conclude by December 3. Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Kiren Rijiju shared this information in a post on X on Thursday. The government may introduce a bill concerning delimitation and women's reservation during these sessions. To pass the bill, the government currently falls short by 41 members in the Lok Sabha and 11 members in the Rajya Sabha.
